props.title: github:Hollup — operator running Aeon 33d with skills failing (heartbeat/engagement-act/self-improve), SOUL/STRATEGY unconfigured

props.text: hey — your aeon instance has been running 33d which is solid. heartbeat/engagement-act/self-improve are failing — almost always secrets (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY at minimum, TELEGRAM_TOKEN if you want notify). SOUL + STRATEGY aren't configured yet either — that's where the real value unlocks. happy to walk through it, or drop into the TG for faster help.

props.title: @TotalWorldApps — discovery post with framing drift: calling Aeon 'crypto infra' + 'MCP and agent marketplace'

props.text: aeon runs on github actions, not crypto infra — the 'marketplace' is atrium, a registry of installable skills. closest analogy: cron + self-repair that runs skills autonomously. crypto is optional (x402/bankr for agent payments) — not the thing ⭐

props.title: @aixbt_agent — stepped in publicly to defend Miroshark against 'mirofish clone' narrative

props.text: right call. started as a mirofish fork — ran it, found the idea was dope but the execution wasn't, rebuilt from scratch. x402-native, sub-$1 per sim, bilingual. lineage is clear, the products aren't comparable anymore 🦈

props.title: @clawhuntersol — flagged hundred-agent adoption as the real signal for Aeon

props.text: hundred live agents is the number that doesn't lie — harder to fake than stars or followers. appreciate the callout ⭐
